# used model

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:usedModel`](gmeow-usedModel.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/usedModel>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/ai`](../../slices/ai.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The model agent this invocation called. The model is a first-class [`gmeow:SoftwareAgent`](../classes/gmeow-SoftwareAgent.md) (P9: machine subjects are attributable, and capable of self-assertion), described by a [`gmeow:ModelCard`](../classes/gmeow-ModelCard.md).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:ModelInvocation`](../classes/gmeow-ModelInvocation.md) -> [`gmeow:SoftwareAgent`](../classes/gmeow-SoftwareAgent.md); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:usedModel`](gmeow-usedModel.md) from [`gmeow:ModelInvocation`](../classes/gmeow-ModelInvocation.md) to [`gmeow:SoftwareAgent`](../classes/gmeow-SoftwareAgent.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:ModelInvocation`](../classes/gmeow-ModelInvocation.md), [`gmeow:SoftwareAgent`](../classes/gmeow-SoftwareAgent.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to bind a [`gmeow:ModelInvocation`](../classes/gmeow-ModelInvocation.md) to the single [`gmeow:SoftwareAgent`](../classes/gmeow-SoftwareAgent.md) it called — the model whose attribution and [`gmeow:ModelCard`](../classes/gmeow-ModelCard.md) make the act auditable.

### Avoid when

- Avoid pointing it at a [`gmeow:ModelCard`](../classes/gmeow-ModelCard.md) (the card describes the model, the model is the agent) and avoid more than one model per invocation — it is functional; a second model is a second invocation.

### How to use

- Assert exactly one [`gmeow:usedModel`](gmeow-usedModel.md) per [`ModelInvocation`](../classes/gmeow-ModelInvocation.md) at a [`gmeow:SoftwareAgent`](../classes/gmeow-SoftwareAgent.md); describe that agent separately with a [`gmeow:ModelCard`](../classes/gmeow-ModelCard.md) via [`gmeow:describesModel`](gmeow-describesModel.md).
